terms.name: filter
terms.definition: A filter that shapes the harmonic content of the sound.

terms.name: filter-type
terms.definition: Which frequencies the filter lets through.

terms.name: oscillator
terms.definition: A source of a repeating waveform at a pitch.

terms.name: waveform
terms.definition: The shape of the repeating wave of a source.

terms.name: low-pass
terms.definition: A filter type that lets the frequencies below the cutoff through.
